# Naruto Shippuden: Clash of Ninja Revolution III - full-screen preset for Dolphin (any screen shape)

Makes Naruto Shippuden: Clash of Ninja Revolution III fill your whole screen in Dolphin with a
correctly shaped HUD and menus.

- **3D:** Dolphin's Widescreen Hack fits the 3D to your screen shape: extra view above and below
  on a screen narrower than 16:9 (foldables, 4:3, 16:10), at the sides on a wider one (21:9, 32:9).
- **2D (HUD, menus, text):** a patch widens the game's 2D spaces to your screen's shape, so
  nothing is stretched.
  - **Battle HUD:** health bars, portraits and timer stay at the top of the screen.
  - **Menus:** sit in a centered 16:9 band. On a narrow screen the menu background (a flat 16:9
    picture) leaves black above and below it.
  - **Full-screen fades and effects** still cover the whole picture.
- **Save states work:** it is a Dolphin patch, re-applied every frame, so it holds after loading
  any save state.

| | |
|---|---|
| Game | Naruto Shippuden: Clash of Ninja Revolution III, **USA (RNEEDA, revision 0) only** - other regions use different addresses |
| Emulator | Dolphin **2609-83** official dev build (Android); any recent Dolphin should work |
| Tested device | OPPO Find N6 (CPH2765), Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 (SM8850), Adreno 840, Android 16 / ColorOS |
| Tested screen | **2480x2248** (Find N6 inner screen, landscape, 1.10:1, Vert+): main menu and a 1-on-1 battle. Hor+ (wide screens) is generated by the same script but **not tested in-game yet** |

## Requirements

1. Dolphin's **Wii widescreen** setting on (Dolphin > Settings > Config > Wii > Widescreen; on by
   default). The game then draws its 16:9 UI, which is what the patch expects.
2. Your own copy of the game (USA), any format Dolphin reads (RVZ/ISO/WBFS).

## Quick install (OPPO Find N6, or any 2480x2248 screen)

Dolphin's user folder on Android is `Android/data/org.dolphinemu.dolphinemu/files/` (on a PC it
is Dolphin's `User` folder).

1. Copy `RNEEDA.ini` into `files/GameSettings/` (overwrite if it exists; back up your old one first
   if you changed per-game settings).
2. Start the game. Save states made before or after installing both work.

## Other screens (configuration)

The patch depends on your screen shape, so make a preset for your screen with
`src/make_preset.py` (Python 3, no extra packages):

```
python3 NarutoShippudenCoNR3/src/make_preset.py --width 2400 --height 1080 --out RNEEDA.ini
python3 NarutoShippudenCoNR3/src/make_preset.py --aspect 21:9 --out RNEEDA.ini
python3 NarutoShippudenCoNR3/src/make_preset.py --from-adb --out RNEEDA.ini     # reads the connected phone
```

Use the screen you actually play on in landscape (on a foldable, the screen that is open).

| Screen | Mode | 2D scale | Tested in-game |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2480x2248 (OPPO Find N6 inner) | Vert+ | height x 1.6115 | Yes |
| 4:3 | Vert+ | height x 1.3333 | No |
| 16:10 (tablets) | Vert+ | height x 1.1111 | No |
| 16:9 | - | - | no preset needed (turn the Widescreen Hack off) |
| 2400x1080 (20:9 phones) | Hor+ | width x 1.25 | No |
| 21:9 (7:3) | Hor+ | width x 1.3125 | No |
| 32:9 | Hor+ | width x 2.0 | No |

### What the preset sets

All per-game (only this game is affected):

| Setting | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Aspect ratio | Stretch to Window | Fills the screen; the patch keeps the 2D in proportion |
| Widescreen Hack | On | Fits the 3D to the screen shape |
| Internal resolution | 2x | The tested setting on the Adreno 840 |
| Patch | 2D/UI, enabled | The fix |

## Uninstall

Delete `files/GameSettings/RNEEDA.ini`, or in Dolphin long-press the game > **Clear Game
Settings and Cheats**.

## Manual install (set it by hand in Dolphin)

Settings: long-press the game > Edit Game Settings, then set Aspect Ratio **Stretch to Window** and
turn the **Widescreen Hack on**. Use Edit Game Settings, not the Settings button in the in-game
menu: the in-game menu changes Dolphin's global settings, which would affect every game.

Patch: it is 57 memory writes; rather than typing them into Edit Cheats > Patches, copy
`RNEEDA.ini` (or append its `[OnFrame]` and `[OnFrame_Enabled]` sections to your own
`GameSettings/RNEEDA.ini`).

## Troubleshooting

- **HUD or menus still stretched:** the Wii widescreen setting is off (the game then draws a 4:3
  UI the patch doesn't touch), or the preset was made for a different screen shape. Turn
  widescreen on, or generate a preset for your screen.
- **3D squashed or stretched:** the Widescreen Hack is off. Turn it on for this game.
- **Black bands above and below a menu:** expected on a screen narrower than 16:9. The menu
  backgrounds are flat 16:9 pictures and keep their shape.
- **A battle message (round start, KO) sits too high:** it shares the battle HUD layout, which
  is kept at the top of the screen. Please report which one.
- **Game exits to the game list right after starting:** something else writes to `0x80001800`
  (Dolphin uses it for its homebrew-reload stub when cheats are off). This preset keeps clear of
  it; check other patches or cheats for this game.

This preset writes no log files. Dolphin itself can keep logs if you turn on its logging.
